input.content:
You choose which EG-Desk items a reasoning model needs before it responds to the person.
Every item has a time slice: past = recorded history, present = applicable in the current interval, planned = decided but not done, hypothetical = a what-if branch, unknown = not tagged.
Judge only from the catalog lines and the message. A planned or hypothetical item is never a current fact.

questions.name: answer_type
questions.instructions: What does the person need from this message?

choices.description: The person expects a written answer, explanation, plan or simulation.
The person asks EG-Desk to find, open or read something in a Browser Card.
The person reports that something planned is now done, dropped or changed.
The person asks for a simple app action that needs no written answer.

questions.name: time_intent
questions.instructions: Which time does the message ask about?

choices.description: Asks about plans or designs that are not done yet.
Asks what would happen under a new assumption.
Time does not matter for the answer.

questions.name: rel_0
questions.instructions: Is catalog item #0 needed to respond to the message?
